race.description: Lakes And Ocean Super Mdn Plate
race.comment: POMELO CHAMOMILE (14) nice Maurice filly who returns from a lengthy break. Stalked the speed two back when second over 1100m at Gosford. Fitted with the two trials and gets her chance from the low draw. LOVE YOU ANYWAY (5) tough old mare holding her form. Made considerable ground from near last on the turn with a handy third over 900m at Scone. Can overcome the sticky gate. DREAM A LITTLE (4) was prominent at the bend when she was sent to the bush for a narrow second over 1000m at Gunnedah. Can hold that form today and overcome the sticky gate. SONGBIRD YESSIREE (7) ticks a few boxes on resumption from the inside gate. Tidy debut at the big odds when third over 1000m at Taree last March. Back without a trial and the claim helps.
